notes.title: VAMPIRES FABLE - DEMO RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I am very happy to share with you my latest work - Vampires Fable. The free demo has just landed on Steam and is ready for download. The adventure is just beginning and I'm excited that you can experience its first moments now. I hope you have fun with it. 

I now have a long and difficult road ahead of me. I want to create a game not only that I will like, but also that you will like. I want to express the fullness of the gothic story that I have in my head, dressed in fabulous graphics and addictive gameplay.

For now, the game only works on Windows in FullHD resolution. Even though I tested the game many times, I certainly missed some bugs. I also know that on weaker hardware there may be a problem with FPS drop. In the next steps, I want to optimize the whole demo and adapt the game to other resolutions. I will also be working on the next chapters of the story.

Your opinions are extremely important to me! After playing the demo, please share your impressions. These will help me continue to improve the game to make the full version of Vampires Fable even more engaging and satisfying. You can join the Discord server where you can find another person to play with, share your opinion, comments and feedback: discord.gg/chJwWZsF4g

Thanks for checking out the Vampires Fable Demo! I hope you enjoy this taste of the adventure, and I can't wait to bring you the full game.
